versions.changelog:
Initial release of cn-color-picker.

- Provides color format conversions (HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV) with automatic recognition.
- Generates 5-color harmonious palettes from a base color.
- Creates 10-step gradients between two colors for preview.
- Works with Python 3.6+ and uses only standard library (no external dependencies).
- Command-line usage with straightforward syntax for each feature.
